Cinnamon Berry & Toasted Seed Oatmeal

#### Ingredients
- 1/2 cup rolled oats
- 1 cup unsweetened soy milk, oat milk, or water
- 1 tbsp chia seeds or ground flaxseed
- 1/3 cup raspberries or blueberries
- 1 tbsp pumpkin seeds or sunflower seeds
- 1 tbsp unsweetened sunflower seed butter (optional)

Seed Oatmeal

#### Ingredients
- 1/2 cup rolled oats
- 1 cup soy milk; avoid almond milk
- 1 tbsp pumpkin seeds

Low-Sugar Nut-Free Oatmeal Bowl

#### Ingredients
- 1/2 cup old-fashioned rolled oats
- 1 cup water or unsweetened oat milk
- 1 tbsp unsweetened sunflower seed butter
- 2 tbsp raw pumpkin seeds
- Optional sweetness: fresh blueberries or a dash of liquid stevia/monk fruit

Faux-Nut Seed & Crunch Oatmeal

#### Ingredients
- 1/2 cup old-fashioned rolled oats
- 1 cup unsweetened oat milk or soy milk
- 1 to 1.5 tbsp unsweetened sunflower seed butter
- 2 tbsp toasted pumpkin seeds
- Optional low-sugar sweetener: liquid stevia, monk fruit extract, or raspberries

Walnut Oatmeal

#### Ingredients
- 1/2 cup rolled oats
- 1 cup soy milk
- 1 tbsp almond butter

Oatmeal

#### Ingredients
- 1/2 cup rolled oats
- 1 cup soy milk
- 2 tbsp Greek yogurt

Oatmeal

#### Ingredients
- 1/2 cup oats
- 1 cup milk
